source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Allowing blood pressure measurements and injections to be performed on the affected arm just as they would be on the other arm","B":"Avoiding blood pressure measurements, injections, and constrictive items on the affected arm, and monitoring for early signs of swelling","C":"Encouraging heavy lifting with the affected arm right away in the days immediately following the surgical procedure","D":"Fairly few specific precautions actually being needed following an axillary lymph node dissection procedure"}}
source_row.rationale: Lymphedema prevention teaching for a client after axillary lymph node dissection includes avoiding blood pressure measurements, injections, and constrictive items on the affected arm, and monitoring for early signs of swelling, given the increased lymphedema risk following disruption of lymphatic drainage in this area.
source_row.source_detail: Prevention Strategies After Lymph Node Dissection
